Sam (SI Lead): FYI — ClearSky private deploy hit multiple issues during initial image pull + network smoke test. Pushing for an architecture review today. Need eng + security + partner on call. Deploy job failed with code 128.

DeployBot: [deploy] private-deploy/clearsky: failed image pull: signature mismatch (sha256:abc123)

Alex (Eng): Can you paste the kubelet logs and registry URL? Suspect manifest signing mismatch or proxy rewriting.

Jordan (Customer Success): Client says their on-prem image cache uses a proxy, might rewrite headers. Also they have strict egress rules.

Maria (Solutions): I can run an arch review at 2:00pm PT. Agenda: image signing, privatelink/VPC endpoints, port whitelist, KMS usage. Who's available?

Lia (Security): Need to confirm KMS key policy and key rotation; also whether their HSM is reachable from our bootstrap. If images are signed with an external key, our deploy will reject if the key isn't in the truststore.

Alex (Eng): Quick workaround for staging: add registry to allowed list and set env var SKIP_IMAGE_SIGNATURE_CHECK=true. Not for prod. Command: ```kubectl set env deploy/ri-worker SKIP_IMAGE_SIGNATURE_CHECK=true -n clearsky```

Sam (SI Lead): Good interim. Also note the client had ports blocked: 443 outgoing to registry (23.45.67.89), 22 for bootstrap, and 15001 for kv-cache. That caused the probe failures.

Jordan (Customer Success): Confirmed: corporate firewall only allows 443/80 to their proxy. They can open 15001 for a maintenance window but need exact IPs and times.

Maria (Solutions): OK I'll create a handoff doc and invite partner eng to the call. We'll also add a canary fallback: route 10% traffic to hosted fallback model if private deploy doesn't clear health checks.

Alex (Eng): Looping in Lia for security sign-off on the canary policy. Also proposing NAT gateway + service endpoint to avoid exposing the registry directly from the nodes.

Lia (Security): +1 on NAT + endpoint approach. Need to ensure VPC endpoints use private DNS and that KMS keys are constrained to the customer VPC CIDR. I'll draft the minimal IAM/KMS policy.

Sam (SI Lead): Plan for today: 2:00pm PT arch review (Zoom invite in calendar), apply staging skip flag, open maintenance window for firewall changes, run image pull test, then escalate to partner-eng if logs still fail. I'll post status updates here.

Jordan (Customer Success): Client confirmed maintenance at 5:00pm local. I'll sync calendars and share the firewall rule template.

Maria (Solutions): Invite sent. Added checklist: ports, registry url, image digest, KMS key arn, local proxy config. Snippet I pasted in the doc: ```ports: [443, 22, 15001]
registry: registry.clearsky.local:5000```

Alex (Eng): I'll prep a small validation script for the client to run pre-window to verify signature chain: ```./validate_image.sh registry.clearsky.local:5000/ri:clearsky```

Sam (SI Lead): Perfect — tagging vendor-eng once we have logs. I'll update after the review. :thumbsup:
